brls:Label.text: Back up `switch/Simple_Mod_alchemist/mods/` if you want to keep the mod library itself.
Back up `/atmosphere/contents/` if you want a full snapshot of what is currently enabled.
Copy both folders somewhere safe. When restoring, delete the old copies first. Do not merge them.
Run `Disable all mods` for each game first, then copy `switch/Simple_Mod_alchemist/mods/`.
